executive_summary: Eighteenth consecutive week of complete failure with zero trades executed and zero P&L. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy is fundamentally incapable of generating trade signals under any market regime — trending up or trending down. This is no longer a parameter tuning problem; it is an architectural failure requiring full strategy replacement. Continuing to run this strategy is equivalent to running no strategy at all.
target_progress: 0% — infinitely below 70% target. No trades taken in 18+ weeks.
regime_assessment: Regime detection appears to be functioning (correctly identifying trending_up and trending_down days), but it is completely irrelevant because the strategy generates zero signals in ANY regime. The regime detector has never had an opportunity to prove its value because no trades have ever been filtered by it.

symbol_changes.remove_reason: Cannot evaluate symbols when zero trades are generated. The problem is not the watchlist — it is the signal generation engine.
symbol_changes.focus_reason: No symbol data exists to inform focus decisions. Any symbol selection is meaningless until the strategy can actually produce signals.

dow_pattern: No day-of-week pattern can be identified with zero trades across 18+ weeks. All days are equally non-functional.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: After 18 weeks of zero signals, parameter adjustments within the current framework are futile. If the Supply & Demand Zone strategy is retained at all as a secondary strategy, the min_score must be drastically lowered (30-60 from current 75) and RR ratio reduced (1.0-1.5 from current 2.0) to even have a chance of generating a single entry. However, this is a band-aid — the real fix is structural replacement.

structural_recommendations.change: REPLACE the primary strategy entirely. Implement a momentum/breakout strategy (e.g., Opening Range Breakout or VWAP trend-following) that generates signals based on price action relative to intraday levels rather than waiting for price to revisit historical supply/demand zones that may never be retested.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Move from 0 trades/week to 5-15 trades/week. Even a 45% win rate with proper RR would generate positive P&L vs current ₹0.

structural_recommendations.change: Add a heartbeat/diagnostic system that triggers an automatic strategy fallback if zero trades are generated for 3 consecutive sessions. The bot should switch to a simpler mean-reversion or EMA-crossover strategy as a fallback rather than sitting idle indefinitely.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Eliminates multi-week dead periods. Guarantees minimum signal generation of 1-3 trades per week even in worst case.

structural_recommendations.change: Audit the zone detection pipeline end-to-end: log how many zones are identified daily, how many pass the min_score filter, how many have price within actionable range, and where the funnel drops to zero. This diagnostic data is essential to understand WHY zero signals are generated.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Provides root cause data within 1 week. May reveal a single broken filter (e.g., zones are found but price never reaches them, or no zones pass scoring) that can be surgically fixed.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a parallel paper-trading track running a simple EMA(9/21) crossover strategy on the same symbol universe to establish a performance baseline and prove the execution pipeline works end-to-end.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Validates that order execution, position sizing, and P&L tracking are functional. Isolates whether the problem is signal generation only or if there are infrastructure issues.
